items.title: Pay coworking invoice for December flex desk
items.quote: Please settle this invoice within 14 days of the invoice date.
items.computation: Invoice date (start of period) is 21 November 2026 (a Saturday, printed invoice date, no separate posting date stated). This is a private deadline between a company and a payer, counted under §§ 187, 188 BGB: the day of the event (21 Nov) is not counted, so day 1 of the 14-day period is 22 November 2026 (Sunday). Counting 14 days: day 14 falls on 5 December 2026 (Saturday). Since the payment is owed by the person (payer) to a company, the relevant Land for weekend/holiday adjustment is the payer's own Land, NW (§§ 269, 270 Abs. 4 BGB). 5 December 2026 is a Saturday, so under § 193 BGB the deadline moves to the next working day. 6 December is a Sunday, so the next working day is Monday, 7 December 2026 (no NW public holiday falls on that date).
